book.lastpraiseofmaggot.maggot_care.page:
The Care of
Maggots

A feeding guide
for Last Praise
of Maggot.

Poop, breeding
and genetics.

May every baby
grow up safely.

Collecting poop

Each time an adult
chicken lays an
egg, it has a 50%
chance to drop 1
extra Chicken
Poop.

Basic maggots

Brother and Sister
are basic maggots.

Feed both Honkai
Poop for mostly
basic babies.

Basic babies take
either parent's
look. Same
lineage, same
look.

Pairing

You need two adult
maggots.

Feed each one 1
poop of the same
kind.

Golden Maggots

Adults only eat
Golden Poop.

Pair with a golden
or basic adult.
Both need Golden
Poop.

They cannot mate
with yellow-
purple.

Yellow-Purple

Adults only eat
Yellow-Purple
Poop.

Pair with the same
type or a basic
adult. Both need
that poop.

They cannot mate
with gold.

Colour genes

Each maggot has
two breeding
alleles. A baby
inherits one at
random from each
parent.

A: basic
G: gold
Y: yellow-purple
G/Y: rainbow

Inspect and feed

Sneak-right-click
with an empty hand
to check genes and
growth time left.

Basic germline:
Golden feed: A/G
Yellow-purple: A/Y
Honkai: A/A
Body stays basic.
Special feeds keep
it heterozygous.

Heterozygotes

Without rainbow
mutation:
A/G x A/G: 75%
gold, 25% basic.

A/Y x A/Y: 75%
yellow-purple,
25% basic.

Special feed is
not a guarantee.
Babies keep genes.

Homozygotes

Without rainbow
mutation:
G/G x A/G or
G/G x G/G gives
only gold babies.

Y/Y does the same
for yellow-purple.

Feeding variants
does not reset
their genes.

When neither
parent is rainbow,
each baby has an
independent 0.1%
chance to become
rainbow.

These babies have
G/Y genes and can
grow up and breed
normally.

Rainbow pairing

Rainbow adults eat
Honkai Poop.

Rainbow x rainbow:
50% rainbow
25% gold
25% yellow-purple

Rainbow + basic

Rainbow and basic
adults can pair.
Feed both Honkai
Poop.

G/Y x A/A:
50% gold
50% yellow-purple

Normal inheritance
without an extra
mutation roll.

Baby foods

Basic: Honkai Poop
Gold: Golden Poop
Yellow-purple:
Yellow-Purple Poop
Rainbow:
Honkai Poop

After breeding

Keep the area
around them clear,
and wait patiently
for new babies.
